_README: Brain-picked platform announcements rendered by https://dchub.cloud/whats-new#platform.
APPROVAL = MERGE. The brain opens a PR that adds or edits an entry here; merging that PR
is the owner's approval. There is no write endpoint, no admin toggle and no cron that
mutates this file. An entry is INVISIBLE unless status is exactly "published" — a draft,
a typo'd status or a missing status is withheld (routes/platform_updates.py::_is_published).
NO FIGURES IN PROSE. The first cards here replaced hardcoded HTML that went stale in public:
it said '36 grids' while the scoreboard ranked 46, and '73 tools' / 'tool #73' while the
live catalog was at 81. So `title` and `body` may not contain a figure — the loader
rejects one (::_looks_like_bare_figure). To show a number, declare a metric TOKEN; the
client binds the value live from /api/v1/canon/phrases at render time. A number that is
never stored can never go stale.
Metric tokens with a live source: tools · facilities · markets · deals · countries.
Any other token is served as UNMEASURED (value null + a reason) and renders no number.
Never invent a token to smuggle a literal back in.
Fields: id (stable, unique) · status · announced (YYYY-MM-DD) · tag · title · body ·
Order in this array is the render order — newest first.

updates.title: The DCPI method is now machine-readable
updates.body: Every DCPI indicator weight, every cap, every verdict band and the full revision history are now served as JSON at /api/v1/dcpi/methodology, emitted from the same constants the scorer imports — so the published method and the live index cannot drift into describing different formulas. The known limitations ship in the same payload, including an input that is never populated and therefore contributes a structural zero to every constraint score.

updates.title: Cross-layer site discovery produces candidates, not rankings
updates.body: GET /api/v1/sites/cross-layer builds a candidate set out of the physical layers themselves — the substation layer is the search space, with fiber coverage, carrier presence, DCPI market context and optional floodplain evidence attached to each anchor — instead of re-ranking a shortlist the caller already had. It also declares what it refuses to answer: constraint_coverage names measured MW headroom as absent from every layer, with the reason, so an agent can see the hole instead of inferring a number nobody measured.

updates.title: The grid scoreboard separates zones ranked from independent feeds
updates.body: get_grid_scoreboard now returns the ranked-zone count and the count of independent upstream feeds as two separate named fields, each with its basis, because one combined figure read as far more independent sourcing than exists — most ranked zones arrive through a single ENTSO-E feed. Neither figure is stored on this card: both move between calls, and DC Hub publishes no keyless grid-zone count to bind against, so what is published here is the split itself.

updates.title: Japan, South Korea & Brazil join the live scoreboard
updates.body: get_grid_scoreboard (keyless) ranks national and regional grids on one real-time renewable-share scale — Japan (OCCTO), South Korea (KPX) and Brazil SIN (ONS) beside the US ISOs, EU bidding zones, GB and Taiwan. Australia and Singapore are live-partial.

updates.title: Spot interconnection headroom before it opens
updates.body: get_retirement_headroom returns filed US generator retirements (EIA-860M) — coal and gas plants with capacity, retirement date and the nearest substations — so an agent can find where grid interconnection headroom is about to free up as plants retire.

updates.title: Provenance Envelope v1 on facility search
updates.body: search_facilities returns a per-record de-duplication tier — a distinct facility versus one of its source records — plus source, a CC-BY-4.0 license and a citation-URL template. The counts behind it are published live at /api/v1/stats/canonical as facilities_distinct and facilities_records.

updates.title: Your agent remembers your shortlist
updates.body: save_site builds a durable list of candidate sites; next session get_changes returns per-site deltas — verdict flips, DCPI score moves, new nearby facilities — not just global market movers.

updates.title: A machine-readable error contract
updates.body: Every error now carries error_version:1 — a severity class and a deterministic recovery hint, plus a server-computed suggested_params so your agent auto-corrects a bad parameter and re-runs without dropping context.

updates.title: cluster_sites_by_latency joins the catalog
updates.body: Clusters candidate sites by fibre round-trip latency, pruning physically-impossible low-latency pairs against SMF-28 fibre floors before any routing. Live over MCP and at /api/v1/fiber/cluster-latency.
